### Summary

## Summary

`uv check --script` applies the global `exclude-newer` cutoff when selecting ty, even when ty is explicitly exempted with `exclude-newer-package = { ty = false }`.

## Reproduction

`pyproject.toml`:

```toml
[project]
name = "example"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"

[tool.uv]
package = false
exclude-newer = "P7D"
exclude-newer-package = { ty = false }
```

`script.py`:

```python
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.12"
# dependencies = []
#
# [tool.uv]
# exclude-newer = "P7D"
# exclude-newer-package = { ty = false }
# ///

value: int = 1
```

```console
$ uvx --no-config ty@latest --version
ty 0.0.73 (4bd2833c4 2026-08-18)

$ uv check --script script.py --show-version --preview-features=check-command
Using ty 0.0.70
All checks passed!
```

## Expected behavior

`uv check --script` respects the ty-specific exemption and selects ty 0.0.73.

## Actual behavior

`uv check --script` ignores the exemption and selects ty 0.0.70.

## Likely cause

`crates/uv/src/commands/project/check.rs` passes only the global cutoff to the ty resolver: https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/blob/76d653943c6c82d3cca03227c24e98b1d0320aed/crates/uv/src/commands/project/check.rs#L721-L725

Package-specific overrides are discarded.

### Platform

aarch64-apple-darwin

### Version

uv 0.12.5 (210d1f678 2026-08-14)

### Python version

_No response_
title: `uv check --script` ignores `exclude-newer-package` exemptions when selecting `ty`
